blocks.title: Both Sides of the Clock
blocks.body: Years of operating inside a manufacturing business. Years of building the Lemonteed archive at night. The two things are not separate. One funds the curiosity. The other sharpens the craft.

blocks.title: What The Day Job Taught The Lab
blocks.body: Real businesses need things that work. Fast. On a budget. Without three rounds of redesign. That pressure made the static-first architecture feel obvious, not limiting. Why run a server when a file will do it?

blocks.title: What The Lab Taught The Day Job
blocks.body: Strange ideas are how good ideas survive long enough to become useful ones. The Lemonteed archive is not a portfolio. It is a place to think without a client in the room.
I take wacky ideas seriously enough to see what they might look like if somebody actually made them.

items.title: Manufacturing Brand Systems

items.title: Internal Tooling
items.description: Dashboards and internal tools that operators actually use. Designed for clarity, not aesthetics.

items.description: The night-shift output. Cards, generators, experiments, and visual what-ifs that exist because they should.

blocks.title: The Protocol
blocks.body: This page exists because two things are true at the same time: practical work matters, and strange work matters. The operator believes both. This file is the proof.
